Test Case Title: Start audio call from female to male
Test Steps: 1. Female opens male profile; 2. Tap Audio Call button.
Expected Result: Ringing starts; 'Calling...' screen is shown; male receives incoming call notification.

Test Case Title: Start video call from female to male
Test Steps: 1. Female opens male profile; 2. Tap Video Call button.
Expected Result: Local camera preview shows; 'Calling...' screen is shown; male receives incoming video call notification.

Test Case Title: First time mic/camera permission
Test Steps: 1. Fresh app install; 2. Female taps Audio/Video Call; 3. Permission dialog appears.
Expected Result: If Allow: call proceeds normally; If Deny: shows error message and call does not start.

Test Case Title: Male accepts audio call
Test Steps: 1. Female places audio call; 2. Male taps Accept on incoming call screen.
Expected Result: Call connects successfully; both sides can hear each other; call timer starts counting.

Test Case Title: Male accepts video call
Test Steps: 1. Female places video call; 2. Male taps Accept on incoming call screen.
Expected Result: Call connects; both can see and hear each other; call timer starts; video quality is clear.

Test Case Title: Male rejects incoming call
Test Steps: 1. Female places call; 2. Male taps Reject button.
Expected Result: Female sees 'Call Rejected' or similar message; call ends; returns to previous screen.

Test Case Title: Male does not answer call
Test Steps: 1. Female places call; 2. Male does not answer for 60 seconds.
Expected Result: Call times out automatically; female sees 'No answer' message; call ends gracefully.

Test Case Title: Male is already on another call
Test Steps: 1. Male is on active call; 2. Female tries to call same male.
Expected Result: Female sees 'User busy' message; call ends; no notification sent to male.

Test Case Title: Male device is offline
Test Steps: 1. Male device has no internet/turned off; 2. Female tries to call.
Expected Result: Shows 'User not reachable' or timeout message; call ends after trying; no crash.

Test Case Title: Click incoming call notification
Test Steps: 1. Female calls male; 2. Male taps incoming call notification.
Expected Result: Opens call accept screen directly; shows female details; Accept/Reject buttons work.

Test Case Title: Toggle mute during audio call
Test Steps: 1. Connect audio call; 2. Female taps Mute button; 3. Speak; 4. Tap Mute again.
Expected Result: When muted: male cannot hear female; When unmuted: male can hear normally; icon changes correctly.

Test Case Title: Toggle speaker during audio call
Test Steps: 1. Connect audio call; 2. Female taps Speaker button; 3. Tap again to turn off.
Expected Result: Speaker on: audio plays from loudspeaker; Speaker off: audio from earpiece; icon changes correctly.

Test Case Title: Toggle camera during video call
Test Steps: 1. Connect video call; 2. Female taps Camera Off button; 3. Tap Camera On.
Expected Result: Camera off: male sees black screen or placeholder; Camera on: male sees female video again.

Test Case Title: Switch front/back camera during video call
Test Steps: 1. Connect video call; 2. Female taps Switch Camera button.
Expected Result: Camera switches between front and back; video continues smoothly; no freeze or crash.

Test Case Title: Female ends call during conversation
Test Steps: 1. Connect call; 2. Female taps End Call button.
Expected Result: Call ends immediately; both sides see call ended screen; shows call duration.

Test Case Title: Male ends call during conversation
Test Steps: 1. Connect call; 2. Male taps End Call button.
Expected Result: Call ends for both; female sees 'Call ended' message; shows call duration; no crash.

Test Case Title: 1. Connect call; 2. Female switches to poor network (2G or weak WiFi).
Test Steps: Shows 'Poor connection' or 'Reconnecting...' message; call continues when network improves or ends with timeout.
Expected Result: High

Test Case Title: 1. Connect call; 2. Turn off female internet for 10 seconds; 3. Turn back on.
Test Steps: Shows 'Reconnecting...' indicator; call resumes when network returns; if too long call ends gracefully.
Expected Result: High

Test Case Title: 1. Female places call (ringing state); 2. Press Back button.
Test Steps: Call is cancelled; ringing stops on male side; female returns to previous screen.
Expected Result: Medium

Test Case Title: 1. Connect call; 2. Press Home button on female device.
Test Steps: Call continues in background; notification shows 'Ongoing call'; can return to call from notification.
Expected Result: Medium

Test Case Title: 1. Male blocks female; 2. Female tries to call male.
Test Steps: Shows 'User not available' or similar message; call does not connect; male does not receive notification.
Expected Result: High

Test Case Title: 1. Female blocks male; 2. Female tries to call male.
Test Steps: Shows appropriate message or prevents call initiation; no call is placed.
Expected Result: Medium

Feature: Outgoing call saved in recent calls
Test Case Title: 1. Female calls male; 2. Call connects or ends; 3. Check Recent Calls.
Test Steps: Call appears in recent calls list with correct details (name, time, duration, call type).
Expected Result: Medium

Test Case Title: 1. Female calls male; 2. Male does not answer; 3. Male checks Recent Calls.
Test Steps: Shows as missed call with red indicator; shows female name and time.
Expected Result: Medium

Test Case Title: 1. Female calls male; 2. End call; 3. Immediately call again; 4. Repeat 5 times.
Test Steps: Each call works correctly; no crash; no memory issues; UI responds properly.
Expected Result: Medium

Feature: Switch between audio and video calls
Test Case Title: 1. Female makes audio call; 2. End call; 3. Make video call; 4. End; 5. Make audio again.
Test Steps: Both call types work correctly; camera/mic permissions handled properly; no crashes.
Expected Result: Medium

Test Case Title: 1. Connect video call; 2. Rotate device from portrait to landscape; 3. Rotate back.
Test Steps: Video adjusts to orientation; controls remain accessible; no crash or freeze.
Expected Result: Low

Test Case Title: 1. Female has sufficient balance; 2. Places call to male.
Test Steps: Call proceeds normally; balance deducts correctly per minute.
Expected Result: High

Test Case Title: 1. Female has zero or low balance; 2. Tries to call male.
Test Steps: Shows 'Insufficient balance' message; call does not proceed; redirects to recharge/wallet.
Expected Result: High

Test Case Title: 1. Connect audio call; 2. Both users speak normally.
Test Steps: Audio is clear; no echo or distortion; minimal latency; volume is adequate.
Expected Result: High
